description: Suggest 3-6 agents for this tenant from what actually arrives: reads the latest N incoming e-mails and messenger messages (default 200), groups them into topics with the tenant's language model and proposes one agent per topic: name, responsibility, reasoning with its share ('23 von 100 Eingängen' — counted by the server, not by the model), 2-3 example items (kind + id), recommended tool rights and whether a matching agent already exists. SUGGESTION ONLY — creates nothing; after a human agreed, provision_agent sets one up. Read-only. Ask the user first which sources to base it on: sources (mail and/or messenger), optionally only certain mailboxes (mailbox_ids from list_mailboxes) or messenger channels (e.g. whatsapp, teams).

channels.description: Only these messenger channels, e.g. whatsapp, teams, sms. Default: all.

limit.description: How many recent items to read (default 200, min 10, max 500)

mailbox_ids.description: Only these mailboxes (ids from list_mailboxes). Default: all.

sources.description: Which kinds of incoming items to analyse (default both).

name: suggest_agents
